sources.note: Town of Warren, Board Members directory (live): the three listers are Sandra Brodeur, Julie Burns, and Carolyn Adams. Adams was the sole printed candidate on the 2026 ballot. Minted elected on the directory presentation, disclosed on issue #163.
Town of Warren, Board Members directory (live): Cemetery Commissioners Charles Snow, Julie Burns, and Brent Adams sit alongside Jeff Campbell (already recorded).

Town of Warren, Selectboard minutes, March 10, 2026 (DRAFT, disclosed): on motion, 'appoint Ms. Behn as a Cemetery Commissioner... approved unanimously' -- Camilla Behn completes the five-member commission as an appointee. Behn also sits on the selectboard.
